title: Ground-water levels in the Upper Three Runs and Gordon aquifers in the General Separations Area, Savannah River Site, South Carolina, 1996
citation: Harrelson, L.G., Conlon, K.J., and Harris, M.K., 1997, Ground-water levels in the Upper Three Runs and Gordon aquifers in the General Separations Area, Savannah River Site, South Carolina, 1996: U.S. Geological Survey Water-Resources Investigations Report 97-4217, map scale 1:26,700.
notes: Pages 1-36 (pdf_text except page 31, an OCR'd table divider with nothing to read). Geology and hydrogeology of the General Separations Area, Savannah River Site (pages 9-25), references (26-30) and Table 1 (wells open to the Upper Three Runs aquifer upper aquifer zone, pages 33-36; continues into packet 2). Well rows were transcribed column by column; IDs keep the table's OCR-like spellings (e.g. 38X-kl5, HSB HOD). Rows for AK-1186 and AK-2111 are split over two lines in the text and were read from both lines; AK-1198's SRS ID is on the line above. Water level is the water-level elevation (feet above sea level), not a depth; screen top and bottom are elevations. Location is the latitude/longitude as printed. Figures 4-9 (pages 19-24: well-cluster diagram, hydrographs, water-level maps) were not transcribed; their values are in Tables 4-5 in packet 2. Consulting and site reports in the reference list (Geotrans, D'Appolonia, Buss, Duffield, Spalding, Christl, Root, Sargent, Cook, Bechtel, Parizek, Westinghouse) and general or Georgia-only references were skipped.
